The '''Ninth Army''', also known as '''Brazen Petard Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Relgim Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the early stages of the Clone Wars, the 9th Sector Army saw extensive fighting, as the Republic attempted to break the Separatist lines connecting Muunilinst and the Outer Hydian.<ref name="TEGTW" />
